titulo.alumno: A local news brief: finding information

intro: Extract what happened, where and when from a local news item. Read the French first; open the translation when you want to check your understanding.

frases.estudio: La mairie a ouvert un nouvel espace vert dans le quartier Saint-Roch samedi dernier.
frases.alumno: The town hall opened a new green space in the Saint-Roch neighborhood last Saturday.

frases.estudio: Les travaux ont duré six mois et ont coûté moins cher que prévu.
frases.alumno: The works lasted six months and cost less than expected.

piezas.titulo: Key words: a local news brief

Point to note: the passé composé presents the event; the imparfait can describe the context already under way. In this passage, «quartier» means «neighborhood».
